mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals an impending monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% month-over-month in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a cooling labor market and weak demand, which together compress corporate earnings growth and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and HOUST falls > 5% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances when UNRATE falls >0.2pp and HOUST falls >5% in the last 3 months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 6 months), further rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 6 months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and business investment, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in <45% of the instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (the 2017 base) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of the instances when UNRATE falls >0.3pp and FEDFUNDS rises >0.2pp in the last 3 months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in <45% of the instances when GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average over any 3-year rolling window.
